name: ap-sql-assistant
description: AP-SQL Assistant — Version 10.7. Adds: (1) Multiple Schema Store and Usage — a managed collection of independently-named schemas (schema-store-engine.js), each with its own version/source/sync metadata, selectable as 'active' from Used Schema, and independently addable/updatable from Update Schema without affecting any other stored schema; (2) a Secure GitHub Connection Vault (credential-vault-engine.js) using native Web Crypto AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2 to encrypt the GitHub owner/repo/branch/path/token, publishable to the project repository and unlockable on any machine via a shared passphrase, with an explicit, honest disclosure that in this server-less, client-side-only application the passphrase itself (never stored alongside the vault) is the real access boundary; (3) a Selectable Schema Synchronization Schedule (sync-schedule-engine.js) with 9 predefined dropdown options from 'Manual only' to 'Every 24 hours', applied uniformly to the Live Shared Schema check, linked File System Access sync, and GitHub sync; (4) Operational Password Management (password-manager-engine.js) replacing the previously hardcoded Update Schema password with a genuine change-password flow, fully backward compatible (falls back to the original hardcoded password until changed), storing only a SHA-256 hash, and requiring the current password to authorize a change. All V10.6 functionality (the intelligent Describe What You Need engine, the manual Query Builder, the CR Builder, Decode, dialect awareness, the Error Rectifier, and existing security controls) continues to work unchanged.
